first_party_leads.not_supported: No original physical v45 rate cells or impression/plate relationship to NLC 1599 or SYSU record, no reason to count this same catalog twice.

date_and_lineage_guardrails: 1599 and 1600 are cataloguing attributions for distinct holding/source records; no causal claim that one is first state or a corrected date for all Xu-An printings.
A catalogue preface or publication descriptor does not by itself authenticate the reviewed original sheet's plate or impression year.

Published facsimile, source manuscript, a 2020 online catalogue, and modern digital surrogates carry independent date layers; one reproduction can image a previously registered original and does not add a witness vote.
Guangdong recommendation index cannot be elevated to original folio or conclusive institutional physical holding identity until first-party object/detail and downloadable image checked.
No source-native 疾度-specific 820 constructor, historical 微 scaling, L132 damaged-rate glyph, G892 limit mapping, or G893 cross-field finals is awarded.
next_action: Publicly seek exact SYSU catalog/item and original v45 source page, or original physical colophon/plate of the NLC 1599 copy; independently locate source-native 疾-degree coefficient operator and intermediate precision. Preserve unresolved L132 rate, G892/G893 field/epoch/units, avoid fee or account dependency.
